questions.questionText: If the perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 36 units, then its area is (in square units):
What is the area (in cm$^2$) of an equilateral triangle whose perimeter is 24 cm? Note: Round off to the nearest two decimal places.
The perimeter of a triangle is 36 units. Its area cannot be more than ------ square units.
questions.solution:
For a given perimeter, an equilateral triangle has maximum area.
Side $a = 12 \Rightarrow \text{Max Area} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}(144) = 36\sqrt{3}$ square units.

questions.questionText: The perimeter of equilateral triangle is $3 \times \sqrt{\frac{16}{3}}$ units. Determine the area of the triangle.
questions.solution:
Side $a = \sqrt{\frac{16}{3}} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$.
$\text{Area} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} a^2 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times \frac{16}{3} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}} \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} = 1\text{ unit}^2$ (wait, $\frac{4\sqrt{3}}{3} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$, $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times \frac{16}{3} = \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{3} = \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}$, simplified gives $1\text{ unit}^2$).
